Advance admission is ¥3,500 and door admission is ¥4,000, with a separate ¥700 drink charge. The venue describes Hong as a South Korean drummer based in Amsterdam whose work combines structured frameworks with experimental and interdisciplinary approaches. Its Otomo profile identifies noise, improvisation and free jazz as core parts of his practice and notes continuing exchange with musicians across Asia since Asian Meeting began in 2005. en.why_it_matters: With only drums and guitar announced, the conversation is unusually exposed: Hong works between structured form and experimental improvisation, while Otomo brings a guitar language shaped by noise and free jazz. POLARIS also places the meeting inside a real Asia-facing thread—Hong is a South Korean artist based in Amsterdam, and Otomo has sustained exchange across Asian scenes since Asian Meeting—so the cultural connection belongs to the live context rather than functioning as a decorative tag.
en.trip_verdict: If Tokyo is open on September 25, actively make room for Minami-Aoyama and let this duo anchor the evening. It is a strong small-room reason to cross the city, not by itself a reason to rebuild a wider Kanto itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: Con sólo batería y guitarra anunciadas, la conversación queda especialmente expuesta: Hong trabaja entre estructuras definidas e improvisación experimental, mientras Otomo lleva una guitarra marcada por el ruido y el free jazz. POLARIS además coloca el encuentro dentro de un hilo asiático real: Hong es una artista surcoreana radicada en Ámsterdam y Otomo mantiene intercambios entre escenas de Asia desde Asian Meeting. El cruce cultural pertenece al contexto musical de la noche; no es una etiqueta añadida después.
es.trip_verdict: Si Tokio está abierto el 25 de septiembre, sí le haría espacio a Minami-Aoyama y dejaría que este dúo ancle la noche. Es una razón fuerte para cruzar la ciudad hacia un cuarto pequeño, no para rehacer por sí sola un itinerario más amplio por Kanto.
